requirement: Implement ResilientJobRunner with run_job and cancel_job managing cooperative task cancellation, shielding cleanup coroutines, updating job status to 'cancelled', and ensuring cancel_job awaits task completion within timeout.
skeleton: Asyncio job runner managing task lifecycle, cancellation propagation, and shielded cleanup.

rationale.teaches: Cooperative cancellation: catch CancelledError, record cancelled, shield the cleanup coroutine, re-raise, and make cancel_job wait for the task to finish within a timeout.
rationale.why: Cancellation handling that swallows the exception or skips the shield still passes a happy-path run. The fixture cancels mid-flight and inspects status, cleanup completion, and task state afterward.

candidates.why_wrong: CancelledError is swallowed and the coroutine returns None, so the task reports as finished normally instead of cancelled.
Only Exception is caught, so CancelledError bypasses the handler, the status never becomes cancelled, and cleanup never runs.
The cleanup coroutine is not shielded, so a second cancel aborts cleanup halfway.
A cancelled job is recorded as failed, so callers cannot tell cancellation from a crash.
cancel_job returns True immediately without waiting, so the caller proceeds while the task is still running.
